result: Low passages cross and divide ahead of you. Tool marks stop abruptly at unfinished stone faces. Between the turns, even your footsteps seem to lose their direction.

The low stonework makes every turn feel close, and the unfinished faces give several branches a similar appearance. You can keep a mark at the last junction, follow the group carefully, or stop to compare the visible passages before choosing one. Your route back is something you can record as you go.
